newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen refraining from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen refraining from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to refrain from open market operations on Friday, analysts said.

"They'll probably do nothing," said James Glassman, senior economist at Chase Securities Inc. "They've got a 14-day operation in place, so it makes me think that they're close to the mark (on the reserve need)."
Federal funds were trading at 5-3/8 percent in midmorning trade, below the Fed's target for the rate of 5-1/2 percent.
